info.title: LUNARA Fast Journal Desk
info.description: Private editorial desk for LUNARA Journal. Uses consolidated operations to minimize GPT Action round trips. Publishing is disabled by default and excluded from the standard ChatGPT editor scope. A separately publish-scoped credential may use the explicit single-entry action only when Control Plane publishing is enabled, validation passes, and Dalton explicitly instructs the GPT to publish. Never schedules, bulk publishes, deletes, trashes, changes post status outside the dedicated publish action, or activates configuration.

content.description: Approved replacement body as publishable WordPress HTML.

acf.description: Only allowlisted Journal ACF fields are accepted.

get.description: Returns identity, health, active Control Plane summary, Dispatch state, newest drafts, attention items, and the recommended next draft in one compact call. Use this instead of separate identity, health, configuration, and draft-list calls.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass the 60-second desk cache only when the user explicitly asks for a fresh refresh.

get.summary: Open one complete Journal editing workspace
get.description: Returns the selected draft, required ACF/source/provenance fields, current deterministic validation, and the active compact editorial configuration. It deliberately omits the full audit log.

post.summary: Save the approved revision and validate it in one request
post.description: Use only after Dalton approves the exact proposed revision. Saves allowlisted draft fields, records attribution, preserves draft status, and runs deterministic validation in one operation.
Queues the feed/AI/image run asynchronously inside WordPress and returns immediately. It does not wait for generation to finish and cannot publish anything.

post.summary: Mark a validated draft ready for Dalton
post.description: Runs validation again, sets the internal ready-for-editor state, and preserves WordPress draft status. Never publishes.

get.summary: Retrieve the audit trail only when requested
get.description: Use only for an explicit provenance or troubleshooting request. The normal workspace intentionally omits full audit history for speed.

post.summary: Publish a single validated Journal draft immediately
post.description: Publishes exactly one Journal entry immediately only for a separately publish-scoped credential when GPT publishing is enabled, the entry passes validation including the featured-image guard, and Dalton has explicitly instructed the GPT to publish now. The standard ChatGPT editor key cannot call this operation. Scheduling, bulk publishing, and silent publishing are not allowed.

confirm_publish_now.description: Must be true only after Dalton explicitly instructs the GPT to publish this exact entry now.

200.description: The Journal entry was published successfully.

403.description: The credential lacks publish scope or GPT publishing is disabled in the active Control Plane configuration.

409.description: The Journal entry failed validation and cannot be published.
